## Baseline mortality model

Observed deaths are modelled using a log-Poisson model with a second-order
integrated Wiener process for the long-term trend, an aggregated seasonal
Gaussian process, and an independent observation-level component. Each
jurisdiction-age-sex series is fitted independently; the primary analysis does
not pool jurisdictions and does not include a population offset. The United
States monthly model includes a calendar-days offset.

The baseline training period contains observations strictly before 1 January
2020. Frequency-specific seasonal construction is retained for weekly, monthly,
and quarterly sources. Posterior predictive draws preserve uncertainty in the
counterfactual baseline and observation process.

## P-scores

For time point (t), the P-score for posterior baseline draw (b) is

\[
P_t^{(b)} = \frac{Y_t - \widetilde{Y}_t^{(b)}}
                  {\widetilde{Y}_t^{(b)}},
\]

where (Y_t) is the observed death count and
\(\widetilde{Y}_t^{(b)}\) is a posterior-predicted baseline count. Posterior
medians and 95% credible intervals are obtained from the draw-wise summaries.

Wave-level P-scores use the ratio of summed counts,

\[
P_W^{(b)} = \frac{\sum_{t \in W} Y_t}
                  {\sum_{t \in W} \widetilde{Y}_t^{(b)}} - 1,
\]

and are not averages of pointwise P-scores. Wave boundaries are start-inclusive
and end-exclusive. Their exact dates are defined in `config/analysis.yml`.

Sex differences are computed as the female P-score minus the male P-score for
the corresponding geography, age group, and time point.

## Vaccination groups

Vaccination coverage is defined as people receiving at least one dose per 100
people, evaluated at 1 July 2021. European values use the latest observation on
or before that date. The thresholds and region membership used by the
publication outputs are stored in the tracked analysis configuration rather
than inferred during plotting.

## Reproducibility contract

Model seeds are derived deterministically from the configured base seed and
analysis identifiers. Publication artifacts are linked to input hashes, source
code, and package versions. The complete model contract is available in
[`documentation/model-specification.md`](https://github.com/AgueroZZ/covid_script/blob/main/documentation/model-specification.md).
